title: Inter IIT Sports Meet
summary: 13 sports, December meet (aquatics in October), IITM's 25 titles, trials.

posts.md:
The **Inter IIT Sports Meet** is the annual sports championship of all the **Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs)**. Since its inception in **1961**, it has grown into **India's longest-running inter-collegiate sports tournament**, bringing together athletes from every IIT to compete at the highest level.

The main tournament is held every **December**, while the **Aquatics Meet** (Swimming and Water Polo) is conducted separately in **October**.

## Sports at Inter IIT

The competition features **13 sports**:

- Athletics
- Badminton
- Basketball
- Cricket
- Football
- Hockey
- Lawn Tennis
- Squash
- Swimming
- Table Tennis
- Volleyball
- Water Polo
- Weightlifting

## IIT Madras at Inter IIT

IIT Madras has one of the strongest sporting legacies in the country.

- **25 Overall Championship Titles** – the highest among all IITs.
- **Champions of the 56th Inter IIT Sports Meet (2025)**.
- Consistently ranks among the top-performing IITs across multiple sports.

## How to Represent IIT Madras

Selection to the **IIT Madras Inter IIT Contingent** is open to all students.

Each sports team conducts its own:
- Tryouts
- Trials
- Selection process

Students selected through these trials become part of the official IIT Madras contingent representing the institute at the Inter IIT Sports Meet.

## Why Participate?

Representing IIT Madras at Inter IIT is one of the highest sporting achievements for a student.

It offers the opportunity to:
- Compete against the best athletes from all IITs.
- Represent IIT Madras on a national stage.
- Build lasting friendships and team spirit.
- Be part of IIT Madras' rich sporting legacy.

> **Dream big, train hard, and you could be wearing the IIT Madras jersey at the next Inter IIT Sports Meet! **
